biotools.summary: seneR is an R package with an interactive Shiny interface that calculates senescence identity (SID) scores, assesses senescence-related phenotypes, and plots senescence trajectories from transcriptomic data, demonstrated on type 2 diabetes (human islets) and osteoarthritis (chondrocytes) datasets.
